name: Kom-Emine
overview: Ten tourists with a guide set off on the "pearl in the crown" for mountaineers in Bulgaria - the Kom-Emine route. The group is diverse in age and occupation - from 18 to 70 years old. Among them are realists and adventurers, "stars" and intellectuals - a famous model, a successful vlogger, a professor of philosophy, an extravagant movie star and various enthusiasts and researchers. All of them set off on the road in the Balkans, charged with enthusiasm, desire and dreams, but also with fears and secrets. And the higher they climb, the more difficult it becomes, not only in the mountains, but also in their thoughts and relationships.
